source_name: CMS Slovakia – Legal Updates (svk)
source_subtype: law firm client alert / legal update feed
why_relevant: International firm with Bratislava office publishing English-language Slovak legal updates specifically on AML law changes, financial advisors/agents licensing regimes and 'Doing business in Slovakia: Finance and banking'. Restates SK-only statutory obligations and effective dates in English.

source_name: epravo.sk – Články / Aktuálne (Slovak legal-publishing portal carrying law-firm authored articles)
why_relevant: Aggregator where Slovak law firms publish client-alert style commentary; observed articles include a year-in-review overview of the most important legislative changes for financial-sector entities and AML/CFT updates. Excellent snowball surface for identifying which SK firms actually write about banking/payments.

source_name: KPMG Slovensko – danovky.sk (Daňové a právne aktuality)
source_subtype: Big Four tax & legal alert portal
why_relevant: KPMG Slovakia's own SK-language alert channel; observed publishing on the AML act amendment and new obligations for obliged persons. Big Four alerts are typically fast, deadline-explicit and cross-referenced to the statute number.

source_name: KPMG Slovensko – Finančná regulácia a financovanie (legal services practice pages) + press releases
why_relevant: Practice-page and insight hub for KPMG Slovakia's financial-regulation team; also host of the Slovak Compliance Standards publication for regulated sectors. Useful to see which regulatory workstreams KPMG is monetising (a leading indicator of upcoming compliance deadlines).

source_name: PwC Slovensko – Daňové a právne novinky
why_relevant: PwC Slovakia's recurring SK-language tax & legal news stream, including seasonal 'prehľad kľúčových legislatívnych a daňových noviniek' round-ups. Restates deadlines and cross-sector obligations affecting banks.

source_name: PwC Slovensko – Bankovníctvo, poisťovníctvo a kapitálové trhy (FS industry hub, incl. DORA explainers)
why_relevant: Sector-specific PwC SK hub; observed a dedicated DORA relevance explainer under its cyber/risk assurance section. Directly on-cell: adviser interpretation of EU financial-sector rules for a Slovak audience.

source_name: Deloitte Slovensko (cz-sk) – Legal & Consulting insights incl. DORA
why_relevant: Deloitte Legal SK states it advises Slovak and foreign banks, insurers, securities dealers and investment firms; publishes DORA explainers and a DORA maturity-assessment perspective. Adviser framing of EU rules for SK-regulated entities.

source_name: Schoenherr – Banking & Financial Services Regulatory news (CEE, incl. Slovakia office)
why_relevant: CEE firm with a Bratislava office and a dedicated banking/FS-regulatory news feed; has published Slovakia-specific pieces (e.g. bank consumer-protection developments). English restatement of SK developments plus regional comparison.

source_name: Kinstellar – Bratislava News, Deals & Insights
why_relevant: Kinstellar's Bratislava office publishes English-language SK legal notes (e.g. AML directive implementation, UBO disclosure rules) alongside banking-finance deal news; deal news doubles as an indirect signal of which banks/lenders are active in SK.

source_name: Legalion – advokátska kancelária (SK blog on financial regulation)
why_relevant: Small SK firm that publishes date-stamped SK-language briefings explaining new financial-sector rules and their effective dates (observed: new Consumer Credit Act č. 312/2025 with staged effectiveness, and the AML Regulation changes from 2027). Precisely the 'interpreter of rules' behaviour this cell targets.

source_name: ULC Čarnogurský (ULC Legal) – advokátska kancelária, fintech/MiCA/AML advisory
why_relevant: Long-established SK firm advising on crypto-asset/blockchain, financial-services licensing, MiCA licences and AML/KYC procedures; historically runs a regular SK legal-news bulletin. Strong candidate for payments/e-money licensing commentary.

source_name: bpv BRAUN PARTNERS – SK articles on AML/financial regulation
why_relevant: CEE firm publishing SK-language explainers on Slovak AML act changes ('Zmeny v AML zákone na Slovensku: Ako nás ovplyvnia?'), i.e. adviser interpretation with practical impact framing.

source_name: LEXANTE – Bankové a finančné právo (SK boutique)
why_relevant: SK firm with a declared banking & finance practice covering financing, security, capital markets and financial-sector regulatory questions; a candidate publisher of SK-language regulatory commentary.

source_name: legalfirm.sk (Tech Regulatory Corporate) – Platobné služby, elektronické peniaze, FinTech
why_relevant: SK practice page explicitly on payment services, e-money, PSD2 compliance and AML/CFT for fintechs and startups — the narrowest payments-licensing adviser page found in SK language in this cell.

source_name: AKMV advokátska kancelária – finančné sprostredkovanie / SFA guides
why_relevant: SK firm publishing continuously updated practical guides on NBS-licensed activities (e.g. how to become a samostatný finančný agent), which restate licensing conditions and procedural deadlines in plain SK.

source_name: Chambers Global Practice Guides – Banking Regulation: Slovakia chapter
why_relevant: Annually refreshed, firm-authored English restatement of the Slovak banking regulatory framework (EU law + domestic overlay, NBS as DORA supervisor). Best single structured baseline document written by SK advisers.

source_name: Legal 500 – Banking, finance and capital markets: Slovakia (firm/lawyer rankings)
why_relevant: Directory that enumerates the SK banking/finance adviser universe (firms, teams, lead partners). Use it to build the complete actor map for this cell rather than relying on search serendipity.

source_name: Chambers Europe – Banking & Finance Slovakia rankings
why_relevant: Second independent enumeration of SK banking/finance advisers; overlaps with Legal 500 but catches different boutiques and names individual partners who are the actual authors of alerts.

source_name: CEE Legal Matters – Slovakia section
why_relevant: Trade publication reporting SK legal-market news and republishing firm commentary; surfaces which firms handled which banking mandates, and thereby which advisers to monitor for regulatory alerts.

source_name: Slovak Compliance Circle (SCC)
why_relevant: Largest SK compliance-professional community (founded 2013 by the German-Slovak Chamber SNOPK with KPMG Slovensko and a law firm). Its event programme (e.g. 'DORA Regulation: A Practical Guide for Compliance Management'), member list and podcast reveal which obligations SK compliance officers are actually preparing for, and which advisers are teaching them.

source_name: Taylor Wessing – Financial Services Matters (monthly FS regulatory digest)
why_relevant: Monthly EU/UK financial-services regulatory digest. No SK office, so it is indirect for SK-specific items, but it reliably restates EU-level payments/banking deadlines that flow into SK via NBS — useful as an early-warning layer before SK advisers localise them.

source_name: Clifford Chance – International Regulatory Update (weekly PDF)
why_relevant: Weekly PDF digest of EU/global financial regulation; structured, dated, deadline-dense. Indirect for SK (no SK-specific chapter observed) but the most machine-friendly adviser digest for tracking the EU pipeline that SK firms subsequently localise.

source_name: Slaughter and May – Financial Regulation Weekly Bulletin
why_relevant: Weekly, heavily dated financial-regulation bulletin covering EU institutions (EBA/ECB/EU legislative pipeline). Indirect for SK but valuable as a deadline-normalisation cross-check against SK adviser claims.

source_name: Slovenská advokátska komora (SAK) – Slovak Bar Association news
why_relevant: The Bar itself comments on financial-sector legislation affecting the profession (observed: 'Advokácia a daň z finančných transakcií' on the financial transaction tax and its amendment by zákon č. 26/2025). Also an authoritative directory of SK advocates/firms for the actor map.

source_name: Podnikajte.sk – zákonné povinnosti podnikateľa (business-obligations explainer portal)
why_relevant: Non-firm SK explainer portal that publishes adviser-sourced summaries of the same rules (observed: AML act amendment, goAML registration duty and its deadline). Useful as a corroboration layer and for catching obligations that firms cover only behind gated newsletters.

source_name: FinReport.sk
why_relevant: Dedicated Slovak financial-sector trade outlet with standing sections for banking, fintech and insurance; covers the bank levy (osobitny odvod), NBS licensing decisions and legislative amendments in plain language, often earlier and in more operational detail than official communications.

source_name: Index SME (Ekonomika/Banky)
why_relevant: Business desk of daily SME with a dedicated Banky section; strong investigative and political reporting on bank taxation, consolidation packages and regulator appointments — the political fight layer that NBS/MF SR never publish.

source_name: Hospodárske noviny / HNonline (Finweb)
why_relevant: Slovakia's economic daily (Mafra Slovakia); Finweb strand covers banking regulation, levy politics and financial-market supervision. Long-standing archive useful for tracing implementation slippage.

source_name: TREND (etrend.sk)
why_relevant: Leading Slovak business weekly/portal; analytical coverage of the banking sector, regulatory burden and NBS policy, plus rankings of banks. Frequently interviews bank CEOs and SBA on regulatory cost.
